newsitem.title: TURKMENISTAN: Turkmen Jan-Oct trade swings into $352.3 mln gap.
newsitem.headline: Turkmen Jan-Oct trade swings into $352.3 mln gap.

text.p: Turkmenistan posted a trade deficit of $352.3 million for the first 10 months of this year after a surplus of $178.6 million in the same period of 1995, the State Statistics Committee said on Thursday.
TURKMEN MERCHANDISE TRADE Jan-Oct 96 Jan-Sep 96 Jan-Oct 95
Notes -- Figures in million dollars, FOB.
The figures do not include trade with the Commonwealth of Independent States. Including CIS countries, Turkmenistan posted a trade surplus of $384.6 million for January to October.
